prompt.name: Knight
prompt.look: A medieval armoured knight on a grey destrier with a darker charcoal-grey mane and tail. The rider wears a steel great helm with a narrow eye slit and a small plume, a steel chainmail hauberk with steel plate guards at the shoulders and knees, a red surcoat over the mail, steel gauntlets and steel greaves, and carries a straight steel longsword and a small steel kite shield on his left arm. The horse wears a red caparison (cloth barding) hanging to its knees under a brown leather saddle, and a brown leather bridle with steel rings.
prompt.team_area: the rider's surcoat and the horse's caparison
prompt.coat: The horse is a cool dapple grey (about #8A8F96) with a darker charcoal mane and tail (about #3A3D42) and dark grey legs. It must not look red or brown: no reddish, mahogany, rust, bay or warm tones anywhere on the horse, because the game recolours red.
prompt.identity: the same rider, steel great helm with plume, chainmail, red surcoat, steel gauntlets, longsword and kite shield, and the same cool dapple-grey horse with its charcoal mane and tail, red caparison, saddle and bridle
prompt.weapon_pose: He holds the longsword upright in his right hand, the blade pointing up and slightly forward, the kite shield on his left arm.
prompt.attack: (1) ready, sword upright; (2) he raises the sword high above his head; (3) wind-up: arm drawn back behind the shoulder, body twisting; (4) the cut: arm and sword sweeping forward and down to the right; (5) full extension, the blade low in front of the horse's head; (6) recover to ready.
prompt.damage_gear: a dented great helm and a scratched shield
prompt.damage_gear_critical: a snapped sword blade, a cracked shield and torn caparison

states.note: anchored on the torso like the walk, so the unit does not jump when it starts to move
idle pose at damage tiers 0-3, anchored on the torso like the walk
